claim_scope: Static audit / saved-result reanalysis / explicitly authorized execution
required_estimand_and_target_variable: Specify the quantity and variable being predicted or optimized
forbidden_actions: Change source inputs or frozen verdicts
acceptance_criteria: Bind findings to actual source positions
State tested and untested properties separately
Use a reference independent of the tested expression
stop_conditions: Missing essential input: finish independent work and report the precise gap
Task would require an action outside the supplied authorization

handoff.mode: asynchronous user-forwarded between separate AI tools
handoff.input_identity: List path, read time and SHA256 for each input
handoff.execution_state: prepared_not_started; explicit user handoff starts a task
handoff.receipt_and_acceptance: Report the task version and source versions actually used; main research agent reviews returned artifacts before adoption; no live acknowledgement assumed
